name: MSI GPU
description: The RGB controller of MSI graphics cards at I2C address 0x68 on the GPU's bus (NVIDIA through NvAPI, port 1), adapted from OpenRGB's MSIGPUController (GPL-2.0-or-later). Card: MSI GeForce RTX 3060 Gaming X Trio LHR (10DE:2504, subsystem 1462:3903), untested. Register 0x3F (save to flash) is never written: the host refuses it. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/msi-gpu.md.
